title.orig: À la mémoire de J. M. Jacquard

artist.en: Michel-Marie Carquillat (weaver), for Didier, Petit et Cie
artist.zh: 米歇尔-玛丽·卡尔基亚（织工），为迪迪耶-珀蒂公司织造

medium.en: Silk, woven on a Jacquard loom; 60.3 × 50.8 cm
medium.zh: 丝，雅卡尔提花机织造；60.3 × 50.8 厘米

basis.en: Public domain: woven in 1839; the weaver, Michel-Marie Carquillat, died in 1884. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：织于 1839 年，织工米歇尔-玛丽·卡尔基亚卒于 1884 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A portrait woven in silk in tones of black and grey, so fine that it looks like an engraving. Joseph Marie Jacquard, an old man in a long coat, sits in an armchair at his workbench, holding a pair of dividers over a sheet of punched cards; a model of his loom mechanism stands at the left, tools line the shelves behind him, and a curtained window looks out on a church tower. Beneath the picture are the words À la mémoire de J. M. Jacquard.
alt.zh: 一幅用深浅不同的黑灰丝线织成的肖像，精细得像一幅铜版画。约瑟夫-玛丽·雅卡尔是一位穿长外套的老人，坐在工作台旁的扶手椅上，手持两脚规，按在一叠穿孔卡片上；左边立着他的织机机构模型，身后的架子上摆满工具，挂着帘子的窗外能看见一座教堂的塔楼。画下织着一行法文：À la mémoire de J. M. Jacquard（纪念约·马·雅卡尔）。

note.en: Woven in Lyon in 1839 after a painting by Claude Bonnefond; the silk names its weaver, Michel-Marie Carquillat, and the Met catalogues it under the firm that made it, Didier, Petit et Cie. A Jacquard loom reads its pattern from a chain of punched cards, and this portrait is said to have needed some 24,000 of them. Jacquard sits among the means of his own likeness: punched cards under his hand and a model of his loom on the table.
note.zh: 1839 年在里昂据克洛德·博纳丰的画作织成；织物上织有织工米歇尔-玛丽·卡尔基亚的名字，大都会艺术博物馆则把它登记在出品的迪迪耶-珀蒂公司名下。雅卡尔织机从一串穿孔卡片上读出图案，据说织这一幅用了约两万四千张。画中的雅卡尔身边，正是织出这幅肖像的手段：手下的穿孔卡片，桌上的织机模型。
